dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel gradients from dark grey perimeters to light grey/white interiors, particularly in the left-central region where several closed-loop annuli show irregular, non-circular outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity dark blobs interspersed between light-colored rings; focal concentration of solid dark pixel clusters is most prominent in the transition zone between the patterned lateral flank and the darker dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three large, high-contrast 'O' rings on the far left; an elongated quadrilateral relationship exists between four smaller dark blobs situated along the lower longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pelage exhibits a labyrinthine interlocking texture where light-intensity regions are connected by narrow, high-intensity bridges, creating a continuous network rather than isolated spots.
